task.description: Implement SVC-01 through SVC-04 backend per src/design/svc-01-04-service-scope.md. Tasks: (1) Write migration GBL-078_svc01_service_catalog_scope.sql: add scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT global CHECK, owner_tenant_id UUID NULL REFERENCES public.tenant(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, the compound CHECK constraint, and backfill existing rows to scope=global; (2) SVC-01: update GET /api/v1/services to filter by caller tenant (global + owned scoped); (3) SVC-02: extend PluginRegistration struct with scope: PluginScope and owner_tenant_id: ?Uuid; add dispatch filter in plugin registry; add duplicate check in freezePluginRegistry; (4) SVC-03: add service+plugin availability validation in process definition activation (DRAFT->ACTIVE and DEPRECATED->ACTIVE); atomic rejection; (5) SVC-04 backend: implement POST /api/v1/admin/services, PATCH /api/v1/admin/services/:id, DELETE /api/v1/admin/services/:id, GET /api/v1/admin/services. All must use prepared statements. zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate must all exit 0. Commit to feature/WF02-svc-batch1-20260610.
acceptance_criteria: Migration GBL-078 applied: service_catalog has scope, owner_tenant_id columns and CHECK constraints
Existing service_catalog rows have scope=global, owner_tenant_id=NULL after migration
GET /api/v1/services returns only global + caller-tenant-owned scoped entries
PluginRegistration has scope and owner_tenant_id fields; dispatch filters by tenant
Definition activation rejects cross-tenant service/plugin references with HTTP 422
zig build exits 0 with no error-set warnings

result.summary: Implemented SVC-01 through SVC-04: (1) Migration GBL-078_svc01_service_catalog_scope.sql adds scope+owner_tenant_id columns with CHECK constraint to service_catalog; (2) SVC-01: service_catalog.zig extended with ServiceScope enum, listServicesForTenant/getServiceForTenant methods for tenant-scoped filtering; (3) SVC-02: plugin_registry.zig extended with PluginScope enum, tenant_entries list, resolvePluginHandlerForTenant, scope validation in registerPluginHandler; (4) SVC-03: new definition/service_scope_validator.zig + activateForTenant() hook in definition/store.zig; (5) SVC-04: new api/routes/services.zig with GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE handlers, admin routes wired in main.zig.
